planning_notes: Two LEDs are wired directly to Arduino Uno pins D12 and D13 as digital outputs.
Time-dependent toggling every 1 second is implemented in the SysML model using the registered elapsed_ms delta (first delta is 0 by design of the runtime).
No serial I/O is required by the provided requirements.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LED state for first LED (toggles every 1s)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED state for second LED (toggles every 1s)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 每 1 秒切换一次两个 LED 的状态，两个 LED 分别连接在 D12 和 D13 引脚。

requirements.text: 每 1 秒切换一次两个 LED 的状态，两个 LED 分别连接在 D12 和 D13 引脚。
